Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The change meets issue #2469. The ignore reason names blocked issue #1950 and the expected optimal-load failure. All three tests, their bodies, and their golden assertions remain unchanged. The decision record gives the cause and the options considered.

Local results against upstream/main `7bcc13a4b71df50648207acb05a4ea9c54ab258d`:
- The trial merge is clean. This head already contains that main commit.
- The quick gate plan selects the `pocket3d_hsm` build. The changed heavy test remains ignored.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --no-run --test pocket3d_hsm`: passed.
- `cargo test -j 6 -p camcraft-app --test pocket3d_hsm`: 1 passed, 0 failed, 2 ignored. The output shows the new ignore reason.
- `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- The source comparison confirms that only the whole-model ignore reason changed in the test file.
- `git diff --check`: passed.

The checks used Rust 1.100.0 and Clippy 0.1.100. Each command ran locally in the foreground, with the compiler cache disabled.

Requested changes: none.

This change does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. It changes no UI or goldens. Safety mutations do not apply. I did not run the ignored release tests or the full release gate. The planner defect remains under #1950.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
